$comment: Shape: globalFacts (object) + map: { canonicalId -> PlatformMapping }. PlatformMapping fields defined in ../schemas/breakdown.schema.json.

globalFacts.install: pubspec: shadcn_ui: ^0.54.0  (pin exact — frequent breaking changes). Requires Flutter >=3.41.0 / Dart >=3.11.0. All 6 platforms incl web.
globalFacts.bootstrap: runApp(ShadApp(theme: ShadThemeData(colorScheme: ShadSlateColorScheme.light(), radius: 0.7), darkTheme: ShadThemeData(colorScheme: ShadSlateColorScheme.dark()), themeMode: ThemeMode.system, home: Home())). ShadApp also has .router / .custom / ShadAppBuilder variants. ShadcnLayer for Material interop.
globalFacts.prefixRule: Widget prefix is Shad (NOT Shadcn). Bootstrap class is ShadApp (NOT ShadcnApp / ShadcnApp.bootstrap — those do NOT exist).
globalFacts.theming: ShadThemeData(colorScheme, radius, scaling, typography, iconTheme, platform). Dark mode via themeMode (animated). ColorScheme tokens: background, foreground, card(+Fg), popover(+Fg), primary(+Fg), secondary(+Fg), muted(+Fg), accent(+Fg), destructive(+Fg), border, input, ring, selection, custom:Map<String,Color>. NO chart1-5 (use custom map).
globalFacts.palettes: 13 presets, each .light()/.dark(): ShadSlateColorScheme (default), Gray, Zinc, Neutral, Stone, Red, Orange, Green, Blue, Yellow, Violet, Rose.
globalFacts.controlledVsUncontrolled: value XOR controller (asserted at runtime) on Tabs, Accordion, Select, Slider, Popover, etc. Pick one.
globalFacts.notShipped: Carousel, Collapsible, Command, Drawer, DataTable, Skeleton, Sidebar, Pagination, NavigationMenu, Stepper are NOT shipped. Redirects: ScrollArea → use Flutter scroll widgets; HoverCard → ShadPopover; DropdownMenu → ShadContextMenu.
globalFacts.motion: flutter_animate (dep) for spring/entrance animations. No native glass; BackdropFilter for blur.
globalFacts.flutterBridge: FLUTTER-ONLY (web target). Native Flutter via shadcn_ui (nank1ro 0.54.0). For web, map[id].symbol IS the Flutter widget (Shad*). EMIT RULE: symbol = map[id].symbol (the Shad widget), stack=flutter, bridge=package, nativeRef=null (it IS the Flutter implementation). NOT-shipped components (Carousel/Command/Drawer/DataTable/Skeleton/Sidebar/Pagination/NavigationMenu/Stepper) -> custom Flutter recipe per map[id].notes, bridge=pureFlutter.
globalFacts.nativeDecoration: GATE G3 (native-decoration policy): a shadcn control carries ONLY native-vocabulary decoration — a lucide icon (the shadcn icon set). The Button contract has NO brand-glyph slot. A custom brand SVG the design paints inside a button (Google's 4-colour G, a partner logo) is NOT native vocabulary: in native mode DROP it from the render — do NOT force it in. DROP != discard: the asset manager RECORDS every dropped glyph in the target's NON-bundled provenance/asset_ledger.json (origin, dims, vector, reason); design render mode reproduces it. Applied to EVERY button the SAME way, incl. social-auth — in native mode every social button (Apple, Google) is a native control and ALL brand marks drop; do NOT substitute an official provider button as the native default, and do NOT keep one provider's mark but not another's. The ONLY native way a dropped mark rides a native button is converting it to a native symbol (SF Symbol on iOS / Material icon on Android), which is currently closed for trademark brand marks (licence + exact-asset requirements).

surface.card.api: ShadCard(title: Text('Title'), description: Text('sub'), footer: Text('footer'), trailing: Icon(Icons.more_horiz), child: content)

surface.panel.api: ShadSurface(child: content)  // or Container(decoration: BoxDecoration(color: theme.colorScheme.card, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)))
surface.panel.notes: Opaque grouped block. Use Container + BoxDecoration for full control.

surface.glass.api: ClipRect(child: BackdropFilter(filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 16, sigmaY: 16), child: Container(color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.6), child: content)))
surface.glass.notes: shadcn/ui web has no glass; neither does shadcn_ui. Approximate via BackdropFilter + translucent color.

surface.sheet.api: showShadSheet(context: context, builder: (context) => ShadSheet(child: content))  // [unconfirmed exact API]
surface.sheet.notes: Drawer NOT shipped. Sheet present per shadcn/ui parity — verify showShadSheet/constructor.

surface.modal.api: showShadDialog(context: context, builder: (context) => ShadDialog(title: Text('Title'), child: content, actions: [ShadButton(child: Text('OK'))]))
surface.modal.notes: Dialog + DialogRoute variant. Verify showShadDialog vs showDialog+ShadDialog.

surface.popover.api: ShadPopover(controller: ctrl, child: trigger, popover: (context) => content)
surface.popover.notes: Also replaces HoverCard (not shipped). Controlled via PopoverController.

surface.tooltip.api: ShadTooltip(controller: ctrl, child: trigger, tooltip: (context) => Text('tip'))

surface.toolbar.api: ShadApp Scaffold: Scaffold(appBar: ShadAppBar(title: Text('Home'), actions: [IconButton(icon: Icon(LucideIcons.plus))], child: body))
surface.toolbar.notes: ShadAppBar exists in extras. Scaffold provides layout.

surface.tabbar.symbol: Custom bottom nav — no shadcn mobile tabbar
surface.tabbar.api: Custom Row of ShadButtons or Material NavigationBar
surface.tabbar.notes: shadcn/ui is web-first; no bottom tab bar. Build custom, or use Material NavigationBar for mobile parity.

surface.navrail.api: NavigationRail(...) or custom Column of ShadButtons

surface.sidebar.notes: No Sidebar component. Use ShadResizablePanelGroup for resizable split, or custom Drawer/Side panel.

action.button.api: ShadButton(child: Text('Save'), onPressed: () {})  // named ctors: ShadButton.primary / .secondary / .outline / .ghost / .destructive / .link / .raw. size: ShadButtonSize.
action.button.notes: ShadButtonVariant { primary, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link }. Use .icon constructor for icon-leading.

action.icon-button.notes: Icon-only button via ShadButton.icon or ghost variant. Verify ctor name.

action.fab.notes: shadcn/ui has no FAB concept. Use Material FAB or custom circular ShadButton.

action.segmented.symbol: Custom toggle group — no native segmented
action.segmented.api: Row(children: options.map((o) => ShadButton.secondary(onPressed: () {}, child: Text(o))).toList())  // track selected state
action.segmented.notes: No native segmented control. Build Row of toggle buttons, or use ShadTabs for single-select.

action.switch.notes: Controlled via value; uncontrolled via controller.

action.radio.api: ShadRadioGroup(group: group, child: Column(children: options.map((o) => ShadRadio(value: o, group: group)).toList()))
action.radio.notes: RadioGroup + Radio. ShadRadioCard for card-style option. Verify group API.

action.chip.api: ShadChip(label: Text('tag'), selected: sel, onPressed: () {}, leading: Icon(...))

action.link.notes: link variant = text link. Inline → Text + recognizer.

input.search.notes: No dedicated search widget; style ShadInput with search icon + clear button.

input.select.api: ShadSelect(options: [...], selected: sel, onChanged: (v) {})  // or ShadControlledSelect(controller: ctrl)
input.select.notes: Controlled (value/onChanged) or ShadControlledSelect(controller). Verify options builder API.

input.multiselect.notes: MultiSelectController for controlled multi. Verify ctor.

input.slider.api: ShadSlider(value: v, min: 0, max: 100, divisions: 10, onChanged: (v) {})

input.stepper.api: Row(children: [ShadButton.outline(onPressed:dec, child: Text('-')), Text('$n'), ShadButton.outline(onPressed:inc, child: Text('+'))])
input.stepper.notes: README lists Stepper as NOT shipped, but a Stepper/Steps component is referenced elsewhere — CONFLICT. Verify; build custom if absent.

input.date-picker.notes: ShadCalendar for inline. Note 0.43.0 breaking: icon→leading param.

input.toggle-group.symbol: Custom ShadButton group — no native toggle group
input.toggle-group.api: Row(children: items.map((i) => ShadButton.secondary(onPressed: () => toggle(i), child: Text(i))).toList())

feedback.progress.notes: Linear determinate. Verify value vs controller.

feedback.spinner.notes: No ShadSpinner; use Material indicator or custom.

feedback.toast.api: // verify: ShadToast / showShadToast; else custom OverlayEntry
feedback.toast.notes: shadcn/ui web uses Sonner. nank1ro Toast/Sonner NOT confirmed in shipped list. Verify; fall back to custom overlay + flutter_animate.

feedback.alert.api: ShadAlert(title: Text('Title'), description: Text('msg'), icon: Icon(LucideIcons.info))

feedback.skeleton.symbol: Custom shimmer Box — Skeleton NOT shipped
feedback.skeleton.api: Container(decoration: BoxDecoration(color: theme.colorScheme.muted, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8))) // shimmer via flutter_animate .shimmer()
feedback.skeleton.notes: No ShadSkeleton. Custom Container + flutter_animate shimmer, or skeletonizer package.

feedback.badge.api: ShadBadge(child: Text('New'))  // variants: primary / secondary / outline / destructive

display.text.notes: Typography size scale xSmall→x9Large + weights. Geist default font. Map display→h1/h2, title→h3/h4, body→p, caption→small, label→small.

display.icon.notes: Lucide icon set via lucide_icons_flutter dep.

display.avatar.notes: ShadAvatarGroup for stacked avatars. Verify image/size API.

display.divider.notes: Note: shadcn/ui names this Separator; shadcn_ui uses Divider.

display.media.api: Image.network(url, fit: BoxFit.cover) // ClipRRect for radius
display.media.notes: Standard Flutter Image + ClipRRect for rounded.

display.stat.api: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [Text('1,204', style: theme.typography.h2), Text('steps', style: theme.typography.small, )])

display.empty-state.api: Column(children: [Icon(LucideIcons.inbox, size: 64), Text('Nothing here'), ShadButton(child: Text('Add'))])

navigation.tabs.api: ShadTabs(controller: ctrl, children: [ShadTabList(children: [ShadTab(text:'A', value:'a'), ShadTab(text:'B', value:'b')]), ShadTabPanel(value:'a', child: A()), ShadTabPanel(value:'b', child: B())])
navigation.tabs.notes: value XOR controller. Verify ShadTabPanel vs content builder.

navigation.dropdown-menu.api: ShadContextMenu(controller: ctrl, child: trigger, items: [ContextMenuItem(onTap: () {}, child: Text('Edit')), ContextMenuItem(onTap: () {}, child: Text('Delete'))])
navigation.dropdown-menu.notes: shadcn_ui redirects DropdownMenu → ShadContextMenu. Verify item API.

navigation.context-menu.notes: Same ShadContextMenu; trigger on right-click/long-press. Verify trigger config.

navigation.command.notes: No ShadCommand. Build overlay + search + list.

data.table.api: ShadTable(columns: [col1, col2], rows: rows.map((r) => ShadTableRow(cells: {'name': ShadTableCell(child: Text(r.name)), 'age': ShadTableCell(child: Text('${r.age}'))}).toList())
data.table.notes: Built on two_dimensional_scrollables. ShadTable (lazy) or ShadTable.list (eager). ShadTableCell.header / .footer / .raw. There is NO DataTable widget.

data.data-table.api: ShadTable with ShadTableCell.header(onTap: toggleSort) + selection state
data.data-table.notes: No dedicated DataTable. Extend ShadTable with sortable headers + selection.

data.carousel.notes: No ShadCarousel. Use PageView or a carousel package.

data.timeline.api: // verify ShadTimeline; else ListView with custom TimelineTile rows
data.timeline.notes: Timeline referenced in component list but not in shipped README — CONFLICT. Verify; build custom if absent.

data.accordion.notes: value XOR controller. Collapsible NOT shipped (use Accordion single).

data.row.api: ShadTableRow(cells: {'name': ShadTableCell(child: Text(label)), 'value': ShadTableCell(child: Text(value))})  // table context; standalone: Row(children: [Text(label), Spacer(), Text(value)])
data.row.notes: shadcn_ui ships NO standalone list/row widget — only ShadTableRow inside ShadTable. Standalone data row composes from Row + Text. UNCONFIRMED.

data.chart.api: // fl_chart: BarChart/LineChart/ScatterChart/PieChart; style via ShadThemeData colors + ShadSurface container
data.chart.notes: shadcn_ui has NO chart component (web shadcn charts are Recharts — not ported). Wrap fl_chart styled by ShadThemeData. UNCONFIRMED.

motion.glass-blur.api: ClipRect(child: BackdropFilter(filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 16, sigmaY: 16), child: Container(color: theme.colorScheme.background.withOpacity(0.6))))

motion.spring-press.notes: flutter_animate is a shadcn_ui dep; use for press/spring.

motion.morph.api: AnimatedSwitcher(duration: 300.ms, transition: (c,a) => ScaleTransition(scale: a, child: c), child: keyedChild)
motion.morph.notes: No native shared-element morph like iOS/Compose. Use AnimatedSwitcher or flutter_animate.
